rows.label: tlk70000010_03_msg0001
rows.name:
Knight-sama of Iira, congratulations
on your accolade.

rows.label: tlk70000010_03_msg0002
rows.name:
...That's not really my
style. Sorry. I'll just
treat you like I always have.

rows.label: tlk70000010_03_msg0003
rows.name:
You're really going up in the world,
aren't you? Such a big change... I can
hardly believe it's the same you!

rows.label: tlk70000010_03_msg0004
rows.name:
I've only ever passed a knight at the
palace, and he was a very old man.

rows.label: tlk70000010_03_msg0005
rows.name:
With a young knight like you joining,
I bet they're getting restless over
there too.

rows.label: tlk70000010_03_msg0006
rows.name:
I hear you'll be on special missions
with Adel-sama for a while, but come
show your face here sometimes, okay?

rows.label: tlk70000010_03_msg0007
rows.name:
I want you to know that
I believe in you.
